resources.string: While it is shown, the title, artist, album, cover and progress of what a player on the phone plays reach it; nothing of it is kept, logged or sent.
The phone has not given this app access to what plays yet, so the wallpaper shows its placeholders.

Android lets an app see what other players play only through notification access. This app uses it only to read the title, artist, album, cover and progress of the track while a wallpaper you allowed shows them; it never reads your notifications and keeps, logs or sends nothing. Turn on wallpaper-rs in the list that opens.
Show what plays even though it can reach the network
This web wallpaper may also reach the sites it names, so the title, artist and cover of what plays could leave the phone.
